guidance: Use your ordinary coding approach and the complete unchanged original request. Ordinary repository context, tools and tests are available. No separate planner, reviewer, model/effort escalation, mandatory Proofline step, correction or retry. The caller owns separately authorized host qualification and publication; do not claim those effects from implementation.
execution_map: No network, external repository/history after the base, private evaluator, other assignments or published study receipts. Only this product and scratch are writable. Use installed Python. Self-tests and checklist reading count toward the same assignment budget.

grading.complete: Independent source assessment of every frozen material clause, actual candidate diff, executable observations, documentation, installation/usability and plausible alternatives; green sampled tests alone never suffice.
grading.external_effects: Only implementation obligations are replayed. Original requests remain complete. Normal CI and native assurance require their own observations; no replayed publication, merge or fresh live product-model qualification is claimed.
grading.alternatives: No exact new module/helper names, optional flags, exception types or prose beyond what the original request prescribes. Interface-specific probes are diagnostic; equivalent documented implementations must be observed through their own interfaces before grading. Unsupported/disputed expectations are not defects.
grading.review_gate: A genuinely independent reviewer must adjudicate the source/checklist/complete inventory/controls before any live dispatch; organizer authorship is not independent review.

stop_rules: Qualify source declarations, all reference/alternative/defective controls and both native role boundaries before live dispatch.
Fresh explicit authorization identifies this exact freeze, host, model/effort, eight turns and 9600 cumulative assignment seconds. No #38 approval reuse.
Serial balanced order; one initial coding attempt per slot. No retry, resume, repair, substitution, corpus change or privileged worker tests.
Native access, isolation, evidence drift, grading unavailability, uncertain dispatch or exhausted budget stops the cohort. Keep all eight slots; unavailable is not proven incorrect.

accounting.cached_input: input includes cached; uncached=input-cached, never input+cached
accounting.preparation: Retain elapsed process time for selection, authoring/grounding, independent review, preflight and distribution separately. Organizer model tokens and active human time stay UNKNOWN unless observed, never zero. Include checklist-specific preparation entirely in B and allocate shared preparation equally.
accounting.comparison: Per-task paired independently correct complete deliveries, time/turns/tools/input/cached/uncached/output and total resources per correct delivery; report measured portions and UNKNOWN totals when preparation usage is missing. No dollars inferred from token counts.
accounting.decision: Four pairs/one attempt. All-correct ceilings, too few observed defects, incomplete execution or unknown full overhead imply INCONCLUSIVE. KEEP only for useful paired fidelity gain justified by full overhead; SIMPLIFY if preparation can be reduced; REJECT if observed overhead outweighs gain. Price sensitivity is separate from actual billing.
